H1800.def: from «01809»; properly, dangling, i.e. (by implication) weak or thin:--lean, needy, poor (man), weaker.

H1802.def: a primitive root (compare «01809»); properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down a bucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver:--draw (out), × enough, lift up.

H1803.def: from «01802»; properly, something dangling, i.e. a loose thread or hair; figuratively, indigent:--hair, pining sickness, poor(-est sort).

H1804.def: a primitive root; to roil water:--trouble.

H1805.def: or doliy {dol-ee'}; from «01802»; a pail or jar (for drawing water):--bucket.

H1806.def: or (prolonged) Dlayahhuw {del-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «01802» and «03050»; Jah has delivered; Delajah, the name of five Israelites:--Dalaiah, Delaiah.

H1808.def: from «01802»; something dangling, i.e. a bough:--branch.

H1809.def: a primitive root (compare «01802»); to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed:--bring low, dry up, be emptied, be not equal, fail, be impoverished, be made thin.

H1810.def: of uncertain derivation; Dilan, a place in Palestine:--Dilean.

H1811.def: a primitive root; to drip; by implication, to weep:--drop through, melt, pour out.

H1813.def: from «01811»; dripping; Dalphon, a son of Haman:--Dalphon.

H1814.def: a primitive root; to flame (literally or figuratively):--burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute(-or), pursue hotly.

H1817.def: from «01802»; something swinging, i.e. the valve of a door:--door (two-leaved), gate, leaf, lid. (In Psa. 141:3, dal, irreg.).

H1818.def: from «01826» (compare «0119»); blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood):--blood(-y, -guiltiness, (-thirsty), + innocent.

H1819.def: a primitive root; to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider:--compare, devise, (be) like(-n), mean, think, use similitudes.

H1820.def: a primitive root; to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy:--cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, × utterly.

H1823.def: from «01819»; resemblance; concretely, model, shape; adverbially, like:--fashion, like (-ness, as), manner, similitude.

H1824.def: or domiy {dom-ee'}; from «01820»; quiet:--cutting off, rest, silence.

H1826.def: a prim root (compare «01724», «01820»); to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish:--cease, be cut down (off), forbear, hold peace, quiet self, rest, be silent, keep (put to) silence, be (stand) still, tarry, wait.

H1829.def: feminine from the same as «01828»; a dung-heap; Dimnah, a place in Palestine:--Dimnah.

H1830.def: a primitive root; to weep:--X sore, weep.

H1833.def: by orthographical variation from «01834»; damask (as a fabric of Damascus):--in Damascus.

H1834.def: or Duwmeseq {doo-meh'-sek}; or Darmeseq {dar-meh'-sek}; of foreign origin; Damascus, a city of Syria:--Damascus.

H1835.def: from «01777»; judge; Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them:--Dan.

H1836.def: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation of «01791»; this:-- (afore-)time, + after this manner, here (-after), one...another, such, there(-fore), these, this (matter), + thus, where(-fore), which.

H1837.def: of uncertain derivation; Dannah, a place in Palestine:--Dannah.

H1838.def: of uncertain derivation; Dinhabah, an Edomitish town:--Dinhaban.

H1839.def: patronymically from «01835»; a Danite (often collectively) or descendants (or inhabitants) of Dan:--Danites, of Dan.

H1840.def: in Ezekiel it is: Daniel {daw-nee-ale'}; from «01835» and «0410»; judge of God; Daniel or Danijel, the name of two Israelites:--Daniel.

H1841.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01840»; Danijel, the Heb. prophet:--Daniel.

H1842.def: from «01835» and (apparently) «03282»; judge of purpose; Dan-Jaan, a place in Palestine:--Dan-jaan.

H1845.def: from «03045» and «0410»; known of God; Deuel, an Israelite:--Deuel.

H1846.def: a primitive root; to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up:--be extinct, consumed, put out, quenched.

H1848.et: from an unused root (meaning to push over)
H1848.def: from an unused root (meaning to push over); a stumbling-block:--slanderest.

H1849.def: a primitive root; to knock; by analogy, to press severely:--beat, knock, overdrive.

H1850.def: from «01849»; a knock; Dophkah, a place in the Desert:--Dophkah.

H1851.def: from «01854»; crushed, i.e. (by implication) small or thin:--dwarf, lean(-fleshed), very little thing, small, thin.

H1852.def: from «01854»; something crumbling, i.e. fine (as a thin cloth):--curtain.

H1853.def: of foreign origin; Diklah, a region of Arabia:--Diklah.

H1854.def: a primitive root (compare «01915»); to crush (or intransitively) crumble:--beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) × powder, (be, very) small, stamp (small).

H1855.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01854»; to crumble or (trans.) crush:--break to pieces.

H1856.def: a primitive root; to stab; by analogy, to starve; figuratively, to revile:--pierce, strike (thrust) through, wound.

H1857.def: from «01856»; a stab; Deker, an Israelite:--Dekar.

H1858.def: apparently from the same as «01865»; properly, a pearl (from its sheen as rapidly turned); by analogy, pearl-stone, i.e. mother-of-pearl or alabaster:--X white.

H1860.et: from an unused root (meaning to repulse)
H1860.def: or dera)own {day-raw-one;}; from an unused root (meaning to repulse); an object of aversion:--abhorring, contempt.

H1861.def: (also dor-bawn'); of uncertain derivation; a goad:--goad.

H1862.def: apparently from «01858» and «01843»; pearl of knowledge; Darda, an Israelite:--Darda.

H1864.def: of uncertain derivation; the south; poet. the south wind:--south.

H1865.et: from an unused root (meaning to move rapidly)
H1865.def: from an unused root (meaning to move rapidly); freedom; hence, spontaneity of outflow, and so clear:--liberty, pure.

H1866.def: the same as «01865», applied to a bird; the swift, a kind of swallow:--swallow.

H1867.def: of Persian origin; Darejavesh, a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings:--Darius.

H1869.def: a primitive root; to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string a bow (by treading on it in bending):--archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk.

H1870.def: from «01869»; a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb:--along, away, because of, + by, conversation, custom, (east-)ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-)way(-side), whither(-soever).

H1871.def: of Pers. origin; a "drachma," or coin:--dram.

H1873.def: probably a contraction from «01862»; Dara, an Israelite:--Dara.

H1874.def: of uncertain derivation; Darkon, one of "Solomon's servants":--Darkon.

H1875.def: a primitive root; properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship:--ask, × at all, care for, × diligently, inquire, make inquisition, (necro-)mancer, question, require, search, seek (for, out), × surely.

H1876.def: a primitive root; to sprout:--bring forth, spring.

H1877.def: from «01876»; a sprout; by analogy, grass:--(tender) grass, green, (tender)herb.

H1878.def: a primitive root; to be fat; transitively, to fatten (or regard as fat); specifically to anoint; figuratively, to satisfy; denominatively (from «01880») to remove (fat) ashes (of sacrifices):--accept, anoint, take away the (receive) ashes (from), make (wax) fat.

H1880.def: from «01878»; the fat; abstractly fatness, i.e. (figuratively) abundance; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices:-- ashes, fatness.

H1881.def: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation: a royal edict or statute:--commandment, commission, decree, law, manner.

H1884.def: (Aramaic) of Pers. origin; meaning one skilled in law; a judge:--counsellor.

H1885.def: of uncertain derivation; Dathan, an Israelite:--Dathan.

H1886.def: or (Aramaic dual) Dothayin (Gen. 37:17) {do- thah'-yin}; of uncertain derivation; Dothan, a place in Palestine:--Dothan.

H1890.def: by reduplication from «03051»; gift (in sacrifice), i.e. holocaust:--offering.

H1891.def: a primitive root; to be vain in act, word, or expectation; specifically to lead astray:--be (become, make) vain.

H1892.def: or (rarely in the abs.) habel {hab-ale'}; from «01891»; emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb:--X altogether, vain, vanity.

H1893.def: the same as «01892»; Hebel, the son of Adam:--Abel.

H1894.et: only in pl., from an unused root meaning to be hard
H1894.def: only in plural, from an unused root meaning to be hard; ebony:--ebony.

H1895.et: a primitive root of uncertain derivation
H1895.def: a primitive root of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation; to be a horoscopist:--+ (astro-)loger.

H1896.def: or (by permutation) Hegay {hay-gah'-ee}; probably of Persian origin; Hege or Hegai, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Hegai, Hege.

H1897.def: a primitive root (compare «01901»); to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder:--imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, × sore, speak, study, talk, utter.

H1898.def: a primitive root; to remove:--stay, stay away.

H1899.def: from «01897»; a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder):--mourning, sound, tale.
